brief:
The International Court of Justice's genocide finding against Myanmar undermines the legal arguments Israel has deployed to defend its military operations in Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. The court's reasoning in the Myanmar case contradicts defenses Israel has relied upon regarding intent and civilian harm.

Western states that supported the ICJ action against Myanmar now face pressure to apply consistent legal standards to Israel's conduct in Gaza.

title: ICJ Myanmar ruling exposes Israel's legal vulnerabilities on Gaza
